Professional Contracting Services Throughout Middlesex County

S. Phaneuf & Associates provides professional construction and property improvement services throughout Middlesex County, Massachusetts. With decades of experience and a commitment to quality workmanship, we help residential and commercial property owners complete projects ranging from outdoor improvements and asphalt paving to hardscapes, excavation and site development, and winter property management.

Our team works throughout Middlesex County and understands the local conditions, terrain, weather, and property requirements that can affect construction and site work in the region. Whether you are planning a new driveway, a custom masonry hardscape project, site development, or ongoing commercial snow and ice management, we provide dependable service from planning through completion.

Our Services in Middlesex County

We offer a range of services designed to improve, develop, and maintain residential and commercial properties throughout Middlesex County.

Asphalt Paving

We provide comprehensive asphalt paving services for residential driveways, commercial parking areas, private roads, and paved surfaces. Proper sub-base preparation, drainage, precise grading, and quality asphalt materials are essential to creating a durable pavement surface that withstands New England freeze-thaw cycles.

Masonry & Hardscapes

Create a more functional and inviting outdoor space with custom patios, walkways, retaining walls, stone steps, fire features, outdoor kitchens, and structural masonry and hardscape improvements built to last.

Excavation & Site Development

From initial site clearing and foundation digging through finish grading, stormwater drainage installation, utility trenching, and general site preparation, our excavation and site development services provide the groundwork necessary for successful residential and commercial construction projects.

Snow & Ice Management

We provide dependable snow plowing, snow removal, de-icing, sanding, salting, and seasonal winter property management through our dedicated snow and ice management programs to help keep commercial properties safe and accessible during Massachusetts winter weather.

Local Experience for Middlesex County Properties

Every property has different requirements. Site conditions, drainage, elevation, existing structures, access, materials, and intended use all play a role in determining the right approach to a project.

Our experience across Massachusetts allows us to evaluate these factors and develop practical solutions for residential and commercial properties. Whether you need heavy earthmoving during site excavation or custom stone craftsmanship for your home, we focus on careful preparation, quality materials, experienced workmanship, and dependable project management.

Whether you are improving an existing property with new paving or preparing raw land for new construction, our team can help determine the appropriate services for your project.
